claims: Artemis II travels at over 17,500 mph (28,160 km/h) to reach Earth orbit.
Artemis II hits speeds up to 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) during reentry from the Moon.
Artemis II reaches a maximum speed of roughly 24,000–25,000 mph when returning to Earth.
Artemis II covers 685,000 miles during its 10-day journey.
Artemis II reaches ~17,500 mph for Initial Orbit 8.5 minutes after liftoff.
Artemis II reaches ~24,000 mph for Trans-Lunar Injection heading to the Moon.
Artemis II reaches ~25,000 mph for Atmospheric Reentry (32 times the speed of sound).
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket powers the crew to the Moon.
The Orion capsule manages the reentry.
Artemis II is set to mark the first crewed return from the Moon in over 50 years.
